selection.rule: First N unique numeric ascending Variation IDs per official gene AND single_gene query; selected before classifications are fetched
selection.ensembl_selection_rule: Round-robin by gene, ascending selected Variation ID among exact GRCh38 SNVs; fixed limit before VEP responses

data_policy: Public variant/organization metadata only; no Sample/ObservedData/free-text clinical narratives in indexed/exported results
reproduce: python -m genomics.cli verify --data SAME_LOCAL_ARCHIVE --job JOB_ID (raw cache required; no network)
published_input: gee-001-input.json.gz: normalized public variant/organization metadata; no raw Sample/ObservedData or clinical narratives
